# Quickler

> Quickler is a WhatsApp-native platform for inspections, audits and compliance records. Any team that inspects or keeps records builds its own workflows, and the people doing the job answer the questions in WhatsApp by text, voice note or photo. The replies generate a structured, timestamped web report automatically (exportable to PDF). It serves care homes, nurseries, schools, universities and the wider estate, cleaning firms and field-services trades. UK-first, designed to work anywhere WhatsApp does. There is no app to install and no login for the person on the job.

## What Quickler does

- Sends a firm's own inspection or audit questions to the person on the job over WhatsApp
- Accepts text, voice notes (auto-transcribed) and photos as replies
- Produces a structured, shareable web report automatically (exportable to PDF)
- Flags faults on a manager dashboard with red, amber and green status
- Stores every record timestamped, against the person, the job and the date
- Gives a group or head office one dashboard across every site or location
- Provides a clean, dated, photo-backed audit trail for inspectors and regulators

No app to install. No login for the person doing the job. No Twilio or Meta Business account required from the customer.

## Who it is for

Quickler is a general system: any firm builds any workflow shape. Common users:

- Care homes and domiciliary care (CQC and Care Inspectorate mock inspections, IPC audits, health and safety walks, medication storage audits, safeguarding reviews)
- Nurseries and early years (ratio and safeguarding checks, daily records, premises safety)
- Schools, colleges and universities (premises and estates condition surveys, fire safety records, playground and asbestos checks)
- Cleaning and facilities firms (cleaning audits, opening and closing checklists, site walkrounds)
- Field-services trades (EICR electrical certificates, CP12 gas safety certificates, structural and site inspection reports)
- Fleet operators (DVSA daily walkround and van safety checks)
- Any team that inspects, audits or keeps a compliance record from the field (UK-first, works in any country WhatsApp does)

Note on terminology: some older pages and identifiers say "engineer" for historical reasons. Read it as "the person on the job", never as field engineer only. Quickler is not limited to trades.

## Pricing model

£20 per active user per month, with a £20 monthly minimum. An active user is a person who completed at least two workflows that month; a user who does one workflow in a month is not active and costs nothing. Dormant users are free, so you add your whole team and only pay for who actually works. Everything is unlimited on a paid account: reports, photos, messages and workflows. Free forever tier: 20 reports a month, up to 10 photos per report, unlimited users, no card to start. There is no time-limited trial. Big team: talk to us. Billed monthly in arrears by UK Direct Debit. No setup fee.
